consequence.statement: The init container and image that installed OpenTelemetry at controller startup are no longer deployed or published; OpenTelemetry keeps working through the module built into the controller image since v1.10.
consequence.remediation: Remove any references to the separate OpenTelemetry init image and rely on the module built into the controller image.

assertion.statement: ingress-nginx 1.12.0 removes the OpenTelemetry init container and its image, which used to install the module when the controller started; OpenTelemetry is still supported because the module has been built into the controller image since v1.10.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names the removed OpenTelemetry init container and image but gives no image repository, Helm values key or other identity to spell the subject by.; applicability: No image repository, values key or setting that enables the init container is stated, so no predicate can be written for exposure.
